author: cms-sw
body: During building, scram runs various edm checks  e.g. edm write config, edm class version check or edm transient class  for generated libraries. Edm checks fail when a library needs specific libs e.g. pytorch has 3 builds ( one for cpu only, only for cuda+cpu and one for rocm+cpu) and to load a alpaka/rocm shared lib scram should make sure that pytorch/rocm libs comes first. This PR dynamically change the LD_LIBRARY_PATH for each edm check and remove the unneeded lib paths.
title: During build, correctly set LD_LIBRARY_PATH for edm check of GPU libs
